title: Behaviour Interactive acquires 7 Days to Die developer The Fun Pimps
content: Behaviour Interactive, the studio behind Dead by Daylight, has acquired The Fun Pimps, the developer of survival game 7 Days to Die. The acquisition expands Behaviour's portfolio of live-service titles. Behaviour had previously shut down Midwinter Entertainment in 2024 amid two rounds of layoffs. The Fun Pimps' 7 Days to Die has sold over 22 million copies across PC and console since its launch in 2013.
